definition: A serotonin reuptake inhibitor, including selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) medication, is a type of medicine that may be used to help manage symptoms such as OCD, anxiety, tics, or eating issues.

reasons: The packet supports only selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) medication in the context of children with PANS or PANDAS; it does not support a general definition of any serotonin reuptake inhibitor or the broader class claim implied by the term.
